video.modeShortcut.action.listening-cycl: Start with subtitles off, then cycle to Original only, Bilingual, and back to Off so you can listen first and check captions after.
video.modeShortcut.action.toggle-visibil: Hide or restore video subtitles with one keypress while keeping your current Bilingual, Translated, or Original selection.
video.modeShortcut.hotkeyNeedModifier: Video subtitle shortcuts must include a modifier key or use a function key (F1–F12) to avoid colliding with single-key player controls
video.modeShortcut.enabledDescriptionCus: Press the shortcut on video pages to switch subtitle display modes; {shortcut} will be used until a custom shortcut is recorded.
video.modeShortcut.conflictInline: This combination conflicts with "{feature}". Change the shortcut below before turning it on.
video.modeShortcut.disabledByConflict: The video subtitle mode shortcut conflicted with "{feature}" and was turned off automatically. Choose another combination in Translation & display.
video.modeShortcut.appearanceDisabledHin: Enable one-key switching in Translation & display → Subtitle mode shortcut
video.localMedia.hiddenListeningHint: Subtitles are hidden (listening mode). Click any sentence to jump playback.
commandPalette.action.switchVideoSubtitl: Switch between Bilingual, Original only, Translated only, or Off using your current video subtitle shortcut rule
